title: A transparent self-model yields a phenomenal self

statements.text: Transparency is the decisive defining feature of selfhood. If a representational system meets all the other conditions for phenomenal experience, adding a transparent self-model necessarily brings a phenomenal self into being. The phenomenology of transparent self-modeling is the phenomenology of selfhood.

sources.quote: the addition of a transparent self-model will by necessity lead to the emergence of a phenomenal self
